work_items.title: AWS Infrastructure Setup
work_items.description: Set up EKS cluster with EC2 worker nodes, PostgreSQL RDS with TimescaleDB extension, Redis cluster, S3 buckets with lifecycle policies, and network infrastructure including load balancers and security groups.

work_items.title: Microsoft Entra ID Integration
work_items.description: Implement OAuth2/OIDC integration with Microsoft Entra ID for authentication, configure JWT token validation, and set up nightly sync service for employee data from Entra ID to PostgreSQL.

work_items.title: Core Database Schema Migration
work_items.description: Create PostgreSQL database migrations for all entities: Employee, AttendanceRecord, Shift, ShiftAssignment, LeaveRequest, LeaveType, LeaveBalance, FacialTemplate, AuditTrail, Holiday, Notification, AttendancePolicy, OfflineOperation.

work_items.title: Authentication Service Development
work_items.description: Build Spring Boot authentication service with token validation, refresh flows, session management via Redis cache, and integration with Microsoft Entra ID.

work_items.title: Employee Service Development
work_items.description: Build employee management service with CRUD operations, manager hierarchy, timezone management, and nightly sync with Microsoft Entra ID.

work_items.title: Next.js PWA Foundation
work_items.description: Set up Next.js 15 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, authentication flows, service worker setup with Workbox, and IndexedDB integration for offline storage.

work_items.title: Shift Service Development
work_items.description: Build shift management service with UTC timezone-aware logic, overnight shift handling, grace periods, and threshold calculations.

work_items.title: Attendance Clock-in/out API
work_items.description: Develop clock-in/out endpoints with device logging, IP tracking, GPS coordinates, and 1,000 concurrent request handling within 3-second SLA.

work_items.title: Attendance Calculation Engine
work_items.description: Implement timezone-aware attendance calculation engine with policy versioning, late/overtime/half-day determinations, and daily cron jobs for status updates.

work_items.title: PWA Dashboard Implementation
work_items.description: Build employee dashboard showing attendance records, shift assignments, leave balances, and upcoming holidays with responsive mobile design.

work_items.title: Offline Queue System
work_items.description: Implement local SQLite via IndexedDB for offline operations, Background Sync API integration, and conflict resolution with timestamp-based merging.

work_items.title: Leave Service Development
work_items.description: Build leave management service with type configurations, balance tracking, accrual policies, and carry-over logic.

work_items.title: Approval Workflow Engine
work_items.description: Implement multi-level approval workflow for leave requests with JSON path storage, current approver tracking, and status transitions.

work_items.title: Notification Service
work_items.description: Build notification system with SendGrid integration for email notifications including clock-in reminders, late arrivals, and leave approvals.

work_items.title: Manager Approval Interface
work_items.description: Create manager dashboard for approving leave requests and resolving offline operation conflicts with audit trail logging.

work_items.title: Azure Face API Integration
work_items.description: Integrate Azure Face API for facial verification with liveness detection, implement template encryption, and build enrollment flows.

work_items.title: Jurisdiction Compliance Workflows
work_items.description: Build consent workflows for BIPA, GDPR Article 9 compliance, region-specific requirements tracking, and consent expiry management.

work_items.title: Audit Trail System
work_items.description: Implement immutable audit logging for all manual corrections with JSON diffs, actor tracking, and reason documentation.

work_items.title: Payroll Export Functionality
work_items.description: Build monthly batch jobs to lock attendance periods, generate payroll reports with encryption, and export to S3 with automatic deletion.

work_items.title: Timezone Calculation Engine
work_items.description: Implement complete timezone-aware engine with UTC conversions, daylight saving handling, and regional adjustments.

work_items.title: Complete Offline Sync
work_items.description: Finalize offline sync with conflict resolution workflows, manager review interfaces, and synchronization status tracking.

work_items.title: Adaptive Rate Limiting
work_items.description: Implement Redis-based rate limiting for corporate IP ranges, burst handling during global morning peaks, and regional pod coordination.

work_items.title: Regional Pod Autoscaling
work_items.description: Configure EKS autoscaling with regional pod placement and pre-warming strategies for timezone-based workload anticipation.

work_items.title: Policy Recalculation Engine
work_items.description: Build engine for handling mid-month policy changes with retroactive calculations and version tracking.

work_items.title: Load Testing Infrastructure
work_items.description: Set up load testing framework for 1,000 concurrent clock-ins, simulate timezone-based peak loads, and validate 3-second SLA.

work_items.title: Offline Scenario Testing
work_items.description: Create comprehensive offline scenario test suite covering field worker operations, conflict resolution, and synchronization recovery.

work_items.title: Security Penetration Testing
work_items.description: Conduct security testing on authentication flows, facial verification encryption, audit trails, and compliance controls.

work_items.title: Regional Compliance Validation
work_items.description: Validate jurisdiction-specific compliance for BIPA, GDPR Article 9, consent workflows, and data retention policies.

work_items.title: Production Deployment Pipeline
work_items.description: Set up GitHub Actions with AWS CodeDeploy for blue-green deployments, monitoring, and zero-downtime updates.

work_items.title: Marketing Website and Documentation
work_items.description: Create marketing website, product documentation, user guides, and demo environment setup.
